data.one_liner: Provides the corner radius value of the current device screen for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Fetches the corner radius of the current device screen using native APIs. Returns a ScreenRadius data class that can be integrated directly into your widget layout.
use_when: You need to adapt your UI layout to match physical device screen rounded corners on Android and iOS.
You want a straightforward way to obtain screen corner radius data asynchronously.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You do not need to customize your UI layout based on physical device corner curvature.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS are documented).
Depends on undocumented or OS-specific native keys/APIs which might change across OS versions.
data.setup_notes: No special setup steps or permissions are documented.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general device and system information if you need broader device metrics alongside screen metrics.
